# model.getLogicSwitch

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Return a logic switch by name or by index.

```lua
model.getLogicSwitch(Name)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Name` | string | yes | or Index (integer) |

## Returns

logic switch

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local ls = model.getLogicSwitch("Test")
local ls = model.getLogicSwitch(0)
```
